uk.A placed Single hole has a handle to dra: Розміщений одинарний отвір має маркер для перетягування; повторне вибрання грані переміщує отвір туди замість видалення
uk.Another bend on the far edge of the last: Ще один згин на дальньому ребрі останнього фланця
uk.Copies the definition only. Assign it fr: Копіює лише визначення. Призначте з «Фізичного матеріалу», коли буде готово.
Перетягніть, щоб перемістити виступ по моделі. Він прив'язується до точок ескізу на грані.
uk.Drag to move the hole; click to remove i: Перетягніть для переміщення отвору; клацніть для видалення
Перетягніть, щоб перемістити підпірку по моделі. Вона прив'язується до точок ескізу на грані.
uk.Drag to move the snap fit across the mod: Перетягніть, щоб перемістити защіпку по моделі. Вона прив'язується до точок ескізу на грані.
uk.Drag to turn the rest in 5° steps. Hold: Перетягніть, щоб повернути підпірку з кроком 5°. Утримуйте Alt або Ctrl для вільного повороту.
uk.Exported by SolidWorks, which usually sa: Експортовано з SolidWorks, який зазвичай зберігає з віссю Y вгору
uk.Material copied. Existing body assignmen: Material copied. Existing body assignments are unchanged.
uk.Move holes by clicking or dragging: Move holes by clicking or dragging
uk.Reopen the designs that were open when S: Reopen the designs that were open when SolidCraft was last closed
uk.Snap to face and edge centres: Snap to face and edge centres
uk.ai.connected_toast: SolidCraft is now available in {clients}. Restart them to use it (Settings > Assistant).
uk.ai.prefs.allow_control: Let AI agents connect (control channel / MCP)
uk.ai.prefs.allow_control_note: Opens a control channel on this computer only (127.0.0.1, port 27878 or the next free one). A program that connects must also show a secret token that only your user account can read, made fresh at every start. Takes effect the next time SolidCraft starts. Off: nothing listens unless you start SolidCraft with --control.
uk.ai.prefs.connect_apps: Make SolidCraft available to AI apps on this computer
uk.ai.prefs.connect_apps_note: When SolidCraft starts, adds it as an MCP server to the AI apps found on this computer (OpenCode, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI, Windsurf, Zed, VS Code), so an agent can use it without any setup. Only the solidcraft entry is added or its path refreshed; an entry you changed is left alone, and the file is backed up first. Off: the entries it added are removed. Help > Connect AI assistants… does this by hand.
uk.diagnostic.empty_boolean_component: there is no body to cut or intersect in component '{component}'; the tool may overlap '{body}' in component '{other}' — activate that component or pick the body as a target
uk.document.changed_on_disk_detail: {name} was changed by another program or computer since you opened or last saved it. Overwrite replaces those changes with yours; Save a Copy keeps both.
uk.document.open_elsewhere_detail: {name} is open in SolidCraft {app} on {who}, opened {when}. If you both save, one of you loses work. Open it read-only to look at it without saving over it.
uk.document.opened_read_only: Opened read-only: Save asks for a new file
uk.document.read_only_save: This design was opened read-only: save it as a new file
uk.file.open.drawing_filter: Designs, CAD files, meshes and drawings
uk.help.connect_note: Restart each assistant to load the SolidCraft server. Each file was backed up as .bak before it changed.
uk.help.solid.combine: Joins bodies, cuts them out of a target body, or keeps only the volume they share, and can keep the tool bodies. Use it to merge parts, to cut one shape with another or to find where two bodies overlap.
uk.help.solid.loft: Blends a smooth solid between two or more sketch profiles, or from a profile to a point. Use it for transitions, funnels, handles and any shape that changes section along its length.
uk.help.solid.mirror: Makes a mirrored copy of the selected bodies or features across a plane, and can merge it with the original. Use it for symmetric parts, so that you model one half and get both.
uk.help.solid.pattern.circular: Repeats the selected objects around an axis, for the count and total angle you set. Use it for bolt circles, spokes, fins and teeth.
uk.help.solid.pattern.rectangular: Repeats the selected objects in one or two directions with the count and spacing you set. Use it for rows and grids of holes, ribs, pins or feet.
uk.help.solid.sweep: Drags a sketch profile along a path to make a solid. Use it for pipes, rails, handles and any part of constant section that follows a curve.
uk.hole_presets.delete_prompt: Delete this personal preset? Existing holes are unchanged.
uk.hole_presets.full: The personal library already contains 64 presets.
uk.hole_presets.invalid_name: Enter a short name without line breaks or control characters.
uk.hole_presets.invalid_parameters: Complete the hole parameters using valid expressions of reasonable length.
uk.hole_presets.missing: The selected preset is no longer available.
uk.hole_presets.name: Preset name
uk.hole_presets.name_exists: A preset with this name already exists. Use a different name.
uk.hole_presets.scope: Saved in your profile for all projects.
uk.hole_presets.title: Personal presets
uk.hole_presets.unsupported_options: This preset uses thread options that this version cannot recall.
uk.hole_presets.unsupported_overwrite: This preset contains options that cannot be overwritten safely.
uk.joint.rigid_group_one_component: These {count} bodies are all in one component (or in the design itself): use {command} first.
uk.material.editor.density_range: Assigned density must be above 0 and at most 1000 g/cm³.
uk.material.editor.save_or_discard: Save or discard the material draft before assigning a material.
uk.material.editor.saved: Material saved. Body assignments are unchanged.
uk.material.editor.scope: Save stores this material without assigning it to bodies. Blank properties and conditions remain unknown. Card density does not change assigned density or mass.
uk.material.editor.stale: This material changed while the draft was open. Discard and reopen it before saving.
uk.material.editor.unknown_card: Engineering properties are unknown. Save may keep only the assigned density and existing appearance.
uk.nav.free_orbit.snap_help: Mouse and 3D mouse rotate through both poles and preserve roll. Hold Shift during an orbit drag to snap the view direction and roll.
uk.nav.perspective.sketch: Sketch editing uses orthographic view. Finish the sketch to switch perspective.
uk.network.prompt_detail: This design links to a file on network location {host}. Opening it connects to that computer and may send your Windows sign-in to it. Only allow servers you trust.
uk.perf.click_for_details: Click for details: frame-time graph, histogram and what the GPU drew
uk.prefs.anti_aliasing_amd_dx12: Anti-aliasing uses 1× because the startup check drew nothing with multisampling and passed at 1×. You can choose another setting above; restart to apply it if the check passes.
uk.prefs.graphics_card_missing: The saved graphics card is unavailable; Automatic is used.
uk.prefs.graphics_card_restart: Takes effect after restarting SolidCraft. WGPU_ADAPTER_NAME overrides this choice.
uk.prefs.history_sketches_note: With Sketches set to Under their feature, the History at the left lists each sketch one level in, under the first feature built from it, whenever it is wide enough for names. The timeline at the bottom always keeps the creation order.
uk.prefs.network_locations_note: Off: a design's linked files on another computer (\\server\share) are opened only from the servers listed here, or after you allow one when asked.
uk.prefs.prefer_free_sketch_points: Prefer movable sketch points when points overlap
uk.prefs.sketch_exit_view_note: Where the view goes after Finish Sketch, Cancel or a double Esc.
uk.prefs.view_confirm_corner: OK and Cancel in the view's corner
uk.prefs.view_confirm_corner_note: While a dialog or a sketch is open, a check and a cross at the top right of the view do what the dialog's OK and Cancel do, or finish and cancel the sketch. The view navigator moves down below them.
uk.render.adaptive_help: GPU only. Independent pilot samples are discarded, then allocate 16 or more production samples per pixel up to Samples per pixel. RGB and coverage variance guide allocation; rare paths may be missed and capped pixels may remain noisy. The final report counts actual work. No certified noise or time guarantee.
uk.render.adaptive_pending: GPU independent-pilot adaptive allocation and conditional Fresnel strata are available. Certified convergence, rare-event guarantees and CPU adaptive transport remain unavailable.
uk.render.advanced_material_scope: One finite homogeneous GPU medium is available under explicit limits. Density grids, nested glass/volume combinations, subsurface surfaces, displacement, spectral transport and unbound advanced material concepts remain unavailable.
uk.render.aging_airborne_help: Airborne dust is a separate finite homogeneous scattering volume. It changes transport and raw EXR, not the surface-aging stack. Existing volume/glass/denoising restrictions remain explicit; no atmosphere is added automatically.
uk.render.aging_empty: No aging layers: the original surfaces remain unchanged.
uk.render.aging_help: Combine up to eight optical layers, in order. Rust and patina are authored appearances, not age/corrosion simulations. Scale is in world millimetres. No geometry, mass or engineering property is changed; glass and passive stages are excluded.
uk.render.aging_target_help: A named target must still match its captured index and name. Global masks are world-anchored; they do not follow moving parts. This is neither cavity detection nor true edge wear. Filter the list to reach additional bodies.
uk.render.all_controls_help: Dense inspection of all current controls. Section pages provide focused editing without changing the underlying request.
uk.render.appearance_physics_separate: Visual appearance does not assign density, thermal data or other engineering properties.
uk.render.availability_projection: Supported projection; see scope and omissions
uk.render.availability_reference: Reference data; not an automatic assignment
uk.render.backdrop_alpha_conflict: Choose this backdrop or transparent PNG output; the renderer will not silently ignore either setting.
uk.render.backdrop_help: This screen-space backdrop does not illuminate, cast shadows, reflect or represent terrain. It is excluded from raw EXR. Geometry, lights and the HDR environment stay independent.
uk.render.background_completed_frozen: The displayed result is a frozen completed image. Editing a background does not repaint that result automatically. Use Regrade for camera-only changes, or Render for a new physical stage.
uk.render.background_hdr_separate: The current HDR resources illuminate and reflect on surfaces; they are not automatically displayed as a panorama behind the subject. Changing a gradient does not rotate or recolour the lighting.
uk.render.background_lighting_section: HDR illumination · separate from camera background
uk.render.background_no_alpha_override: A camera background is not added to transparent output silently. Raw-master regrading uses captured coverage and does not reapply denoising; the source EXR remains unchanged.
uk.render.background_not_light: Background color is presentation, not an additional lighting source.
uk.render.background_stage_occlusion: This shot includes physical stage geometry. A large floor or wall can fill the frame and hide a camera-only background. Clear or resize the stage deliberately, or change its physical reflectance. Regrading cannot remove captured geometry.
uk.render.background_workflow: Choose the background you intend: a camera-only colour/gradient, a physical stage that receives light, or HDR illumination. They are independent. Live Preview is a modelling view; render a new image or regrade a retained master to see camera finishing.
uk.render.base_apply_help: One undoable visual assignment to the reviewed exact body. Existing face-specific looks and engineering materials remain separate.
uk.render.base_opaque_only: This editor preserves opaque body semantics. Use the explicit glass controls for optical transmission.
uk.render.bloom_help: Creative output-only glow from positive linear highlights, spread with three normalized box passes. Radius is in output pixels. Added in linear display light before sRGB; not a lens, volumetric effect or convergence improvement. The raw EXR is unchanged.
uk.render.bloom_opaque: Bloom requires opaque output. Transparent PNG is refused, not silently flattened.
uk.render.camera_exact_help: World millimeters; angles are displayed in degrees and saved as radians. Navigation uses the same camera as the viewport.
uk.render.cpu_aa_help: Spatial samples: more samples improve edges and increase render time.
uk.render.cpu_area_editor_help: Full side vectors in millimeters; U cross V points towards the emitting side. This differs from GPU half-edge vectors.
uk.render.cpu_binding_stale: The scene changed. Confirm this reflection target again before rendering.
uk.render.cpu_body_filter_more: Refine the filter to see more bodies.
uk.render.cpu_body_missing: A reflection target is missing, hidden, ambiguous or has a name longer than 128 bytes. Choose it again.
uk.render.cpu_budget_help: Choose larger limits explicitly. Resolution and samples are never reduced automatically.
uk.render.cpu_budget_not_guarantee: These are admission ceilings, not a RAM reservation or a speed guarantee. Geometry, film and retained previews share the memory budget; rendering remains cancellable.
uk.render.cpu_budget_resize: The draft exceeds this CPU profile or its camera-sample budget. Accept smaller dimensions explicitly or select a larger profile.
uk.render.cpu_check_capture_help: Check and Start verify the same file digest or use the embedded HDR. Each image keeps its captured source.
uk.render.cpu_check_changed: The controls or model changed after this check. Check again before rendering.
uk.render.cpu_constant_help: Constant radiance is visible to reflected or transmitted rays. It does not provide direct diffuse lighting.
uk.render.cpu_custom_directions: Replace preset with custom directional lights
uk.render.cpu_environment_background: The image background stays separate from environment lighting.
uk.render.cpu_environment_bounds: CPU intensity must be 0–64, HDR rotation finite within ±1,000,000 radians, and HDR samples 1, 4, 16 or 64.
uk.render.cpu_exposure_help: CPU exposure must be between −16 and 16 EV. A GPU exposure outside that range is retained until you change it.
uk.render.cpu_hdr_help: Radiance .hdr, 2:1 panorama, up to 2048 × 1024 and 16 MiB. CPU requires explicit sRGB/D65 primaries in the file; unspecified primaries and EXR are refused.
uk.render.cpu_hdr_reflection_help: HDR rough reflections require fully metallic body and face surfaces. Check reports unsupported combinations.
uk.render.cpu_light_help: Up to eight directional lights. An empty custom list turns them off; selecting a preset restores its lights. Colors are linear RGB and intensity is relative, not watts.
uk.render.cpu_opaque_required: CPU ray tracing needs an opaque background. Clear Transparent background to continue.
uk.render.cpu_options_pending: This CPU panel cannot edit emission, surface effects, glass or anisotropy yet. Clear those API options before using it.
uk.render.cpu_point_help: Up to eight point lights, added to the selected directional lighting. Distances are in mm; the minimum must not exceed the reference distance.
uk.render.cpu_progressive_help: Accumulate the existing CPU integrator in passes of one primary sample. Selected reflections require one sample; area lights, dielectrics and anisotropy require Single image.
uk.render.cpu_progressive_limits: At most 1,048,576 pixels and 16,777,216 pixel × sample evaluations. Changing samples never resizes the image automatically.
uk.render.cpu_reflection_empty: No bodies selected: scene reflections are off.
uk.render.cpu_reflection_help: Choose bodies and set Off, Mirror or Rough. Rough uses the assigned surface roughness. More samples and bounces increase time; this is bounded specular transport, not global illumination.
uk.render.cpu_reflection_limit: Up to 64 reflected bodies are supported.
uk.render.cpu_runtime_help: Numeric light and environment settings are saved with the setup. Body reflections and HDR files remain temporary. Existing area-light and spot-cone values are retained.
uk.render.cpu_summary: CPU ray tracing · reflections · HDR · directional and point lights
uk.render.draft_confirm_help: The current render draft has unapplied edits. Save them before switching, discard them explicitly, or keep editing.
uk.render.effects_gpu_only: These effects require GPU path tracing. Changing the page never switches the renderer automatically.
uk.render.effects_help: Combine ordered colour looks and image-space lens effects. Rendering and raw-master regrading use the same saved settings. Raw EXR stays unchanged. These are original artistic controls, not calibrated lens or branded-film emulations.
uk.render.exr_pending: GPU can retain raw linear EXR. Compression, multilayer images and auxiliary render passes remain unavailable.
uk.render.gpu_options_help: Samples, depth, seed and exposure are saved with this setup. Only the active image method is saved.
uk.render.gpu_path_first_setup: The first setup on this GPU can take several minutes; SolidCraft stays usable meanwhile. Later starts reuse the compiled shaders where the driver keeps them.
uk.render.gpu_unavailable: GPU path tracing is not ready on this device.
uk.render.hdr_embedded_help: Rendering uses the bytes included in the design; the original file is no longer needed.
uk.render.hdr_file_captured: HDR file checked. Save will embed these bytes; if the file changes, check it again explicitly.
uk.render.hdr_inspect_required: Select and check an HDR file before saving or rendering.
uk.render.hdr_primaries_declared: The source declares its color primaries.
uk.render.hdr_primaries_undeclared: The source does not declare primaries; review the renderer color requirements.
uk.render.hdr_resource_missing: This design is missing the saved HDR resource.
uk.render.image_scene_stale: Finish the modelling gesture or refresh the scene before checking or starting an image.
uk.render.lens_effects_help: Flare uses up to four separated bright sources in the actual linear image. Ghosts, halo, streaks, chromatic offsets and radial distortion are artistic image-space approximations. Spatial effects need opaque output; outside samples extend the image edge. Grain is deterministic. No physics, EXR or geometry is altered.
uk.render.library_applied: Resource projection applied. Check the complete render request before starting.
uk.render.library_authored_help: Original authored resources are illustrative, not measured engineering data. Each action applies only its stated projection.
uk.render.library_emitters_only_ack: Use emitters only; omit the documented passive cards
uk.render.library_empty: No matching resources. Try a different query or availability filter.
uk.render.library_hdr_help: Embeds the original HDR in the saved setup. The authored longitude origin is converted explicitly; no external file is needed after saving.
uk.render.library_inspect_only: Select to inspect; nothing is applied automatically. Favorites and recent history belong to this open document session.
uk.render.library_maps_help: Built-in maps can be saved with pinned sources and local occurrence mapping. Temporary optical overrides remain a separate mode.
uk.render.library_replace_studio: Replace saved lighting, environment and stage
uk.render.library_rig_help: Fit once at an explicit center and physical extent. Complete rigs include passive cards; calibration blockers still refuse. Conservative emitter/card clearance is checked before saving.
uk.render.library_select_hint: Choose a resource in the Library to inspect its supported actions and limitations.
uk.render.library_source_preview_help: Authored base-color source map. This is not a rendered or measured material preview.
uk.render.library_specification_only: Specification only: not a complete executable preset. Required effects, resources and subject roles still need explicit implementation and binding.
uk.render.library_uniform_ack: Use the uniform approximation without spatial or advanced effects
uk.render.linear_help: Keeps a 32-bit float RGBA master before denoising, exposure, tone mapping, filters and backdrop. Linear sRGB/D65; coverage-premultiplied. Additional memory is admitted explicitly. No compression or extra passes.
uk.render.linear_unavailable: The selected completed frame has no retained EXR. Enable retention before rendering; an older PNG cannot recover raw radiance.
uk.render.material_certification: Closed glass uses geometric distance. Topology, orientation, overlap and optical boundaries are checked during GPU preparation; Check only admits the request.
uk.render.material_coat: Clear coat over the base material
uk.render.material_coat_help: Illustrative dielectric coating over the existing opaque appearance. Zero weight leaves the base unchanged.
uk.render.material_filter_help: Up to 128 matching bodies are shown. Refine the filter for large scenes.
uk.render.material_glass_enable: Use physical glass on this body
uk.render.material_glass_exclusive: Glass cannot share a body with clear coat or runtime maps in this renderer.
uk.render.material_glass_help: Original illustrative recipes. Swatches show transmittance, not a rendered preview. Absorption is −ln(linear transmittance) / reference distance; alpha is unchanged.
uk.render.material_gpu_required: These active material overrides require GPU path tracing. Select GPU or disable the overrides before Check or Start.
uk.render.material_limits: At most 128 body overrides, 32 disjoint glass bodies, 64 coats and 128 texture bindings. Identical maps share storage; actual device and total memory limits still apply.
uk.render.material_map_invalid: Map paths must be bounded local paths; normal strength must be finite and between 0 and 1.
uk.render.material_map_required: Choose a color image or a normal image before using maps.
uk.render.material_maps_enable: Enable maps for this opaque body
uk.render.material_maps_help: PNG/JPEG up to 1024×1024; 16 MiB encoded total. U and V are orthogonal world-mm repeat vectors (maximum 128 repeats). Color is sRGB; normal data uses OpenGL +Y. Files are captured at Check/Start.
uk.render.material_refresh_needed: Scene changed. Refresh the body list before adding a target.
uk.render.material_repeat_u: One U repeat X · Y · Z (mm)
uk.render.material_repeat_v: One V repeat X · Y · Z (mm)
uk.render.material_revalidate_needed: This assignment belongs to an earlier scene revision. Revalidate its exact body identity before rendering.
uk.render.material_target_missing: The body ordinal and name no longer match. Remove this assignment and explicitly choose the intended body again.
uk.render.material_transient: Temporary optical overrides for this document tab. They are not saved in the design, render setup or material library.
uk.render.material_v_up: Texture V points upward in the image
uk.render.method_limit_raster: Raster uses the fixed opaque studio preview. Select an explicit raytracing method for supported optical controls.
uk.render.nested_help: Up to 16 containing layers; every parent must be convex and every child strictly inside it. Intersections, touching surfaces, thin sheets and straight-shadow transmission refuse. Camera-inside state follows the certified hierarchy. Does not create a liquid surface or merge touching CAD boundaries.
uk.render.optics_replace: Replace this target’s saved optics explicitly
uk.render.optics_save: Save these optics to the setup
uk.render.optics_saved_help: Exact definition, feature and occurrence identity survives offline reopen. Missing/replaced/hidden targets refuse; engineering materials are unchanged. Save or discard numeric edits before removing a saved target.
uk.render.output_format_status: PNG is the exact completed display image. Optional GPU EXR retains raw scene-linear FLOAT32 radiance before display filters. Export never substitutes the preview cache or a different job.
uk.render.output_over_budget: The requested image exceeds the selected resource envelope. Choose a compatible size or profile explicitly; no automatic downgrade occurs.
uk.render.output_ratio_refused: The linked dimension exceeds this method’s size limit. The previous size is retained; unlock the ratio or choose a smaller value.
uk.render.passive_stage_help: Finite passive panels belong only to rendered images. They do not add CAD bodies or mass. Placement is fixed after applying; intersecting product bounds refuse. CPU does not provide diffuse bounce lighting.
uk.render.physical_acknowledge: I understand this partial reference needs grade, condition and source review
uk.render.physical_background_help: Real passive floor and wall, separate from the camera backdrop. Cyclorama uses 24 polygonal strips; it is not an infinite or analytically smooth surface. Replaces the saved stage only with your consent.
uk.render.physical_copy_plan: Copy plan with sources and omissions
uk.render.physical_omissions: Properties not representable in the native card
uk.render.physical_plan_only: Read-only plan prepared. No material was created or assigned. Keep its extended profile and omissions when reviewing the native card.
uk.render.physical_separate: Appearance is not material identification. These are sourced references, not certified effective properties. Existing mass, engineering materials and optics are unchanged.
uk.render.physical_unknown: No numerical candidate is established. Grade, formulation or construction must be specified; unknown is not zero.
uk.render.post_help: Creative presentation only. RGB gains precede tone mapping; contrast, saturation and vignette follow in display-linear light. Start Render creates new transport samples. Regrade uses the selected retained raw master without denoising or new rays.
uk.render.preview_image_settings_help: Live Preview keeps fixed studio lighting. Exposure and image lighting apply to the image job when you Check or Start.
uk.render.preview_unavailable_help: The live preview is unavailable. Saved setups and image-job controls remain accessible. Change the scene or explicitly retry; a refused scene is not rebuilt on every frame.
uk.render.preview_upload_help: Exact preview vertex bytes, not total GPU or process memory. Geometry is not simplified. Image jobs use their own admission and lighting.
uk.render.progressive_image_summary: Preview PNG · PBR and glass · progressive samples
uk.render.quality_ack: Acknowledge the fixed-budget projection and omissions
uk.render.quality_projection_help: Q presets include future requirements. This action projects only a supported fixed-sample PNG budget and explicitly omits adaptive stopping, raw linear output and independent transmission limits.
uk.render.queue_pending: There is no automatic production queue or animation renderer in this UI. Completed still images remain separately exportable.
uk.render.regrade_help: Creates a separate PNG from the selected completed raw master, using these presentation controls. Does not trace rays, change the captured size/camera/lights, or overwrite the EXR. Denoising is not reapplied: raw masters do not retain its guides. The derivative remains exportable through the same job controls.
uk.render.replace_saved_surface: Replace an existing saved binding for this target
uk.render.result_actual_help: One image pixel per display pixel.
uk.render.result_current: The captured model revision is current.
uk.render.result_empty: No completed image yet. Check the settings, then start a render.
uk.render.result_navigation: Pan and zoom use Navigation preferences. Space + drag pans.
uk.render.result_open: Open the completed image in the main canvas.
uk.render.result_provisional_help: This checkpoint is not exportable. Export keeps the last completed result; cancellation returns to that result.
uk.render.result_reduced_display: Display preview reduced to the viewport device/cache limit. The retained PNG and export keep full resolution; native 100% inspection is unavailable for this reduced view.
uk.render.result_retained: Showing the last completed image; a newer render has not replaced it.
uk.render.review_stale: This review is stale. Resolve or check again before applying.
uk.render.ribbon_check_help: Validate the exact current draft that Render will submit. No renderer fallback, silent resize or resource replacement.
uk.render.ribbon_environment_help: HDR illumination, camera-only backgrounds and physical stage surfaces are separate controls with explicit replacement consent.
uk.render.ribbon_finish_dialog: Finish the current file or confirmation dialog first.
uk.render.ribbon_job_active: A render is already running; cancel it explicitly before starting another.
uk.render.ribbon_lights_help: Inspect authored rigs or edit supported lights without replacing the current setup until you explicitly apply the change.
uk.render.ribbon_materials_help: Open the shared appearance inspector and original surface library. Optical edits never silently change engineering properties.
uk.render.ribbon_no_active_job: There is no active render to cancel.
uk.render.ribbon_no_result: Complete a render before exporting its exact image.
uk.render.ribbon_no_saved_camera: Save a shot before restoring its camera.
uk.render.ribbon_studios_help: Browse implemented studio compositions and review their replacements before applying. Concept-only scenes remain labelled.
uk.render.saved_maps_runtime_conflict: Saved surface bindings cannot be mixed with temporary optical overrides or an unsaved HDR. Save the HDR or remove the temporary inputs explicitly.
uk.render.saved_surfaces_help: Pinned built-in maps follow the selected occurrence in local millimeters. A replaced or missing target is an error, never an automatic reassignment.
uk.render.scene_consent: Confirm lighting, environment, exposure and stage replacement
uk.render.scene_preserved_fields: Camera, sampling, dimensions, optical bindings, CAD geometry and engineering materials are preserved.
uk.render.scene_preserves_design: Compose lighting and a passive stage for the visible subject. Geometry, engineering materials and the camera remain separate.
uk.render.scene_review_help: Review the complete native composition before applying. Unbound advanced SCENE specifications are not substituted.
uk.render.setup_legacy_environment: This older setup uses legacy environment rotation or intensity. Those values are retained; convert them explicitly before saving a full image job.
uk.render.setup_numeric_help: Save records the active image method and all its numeric settings. Reload or choosing another setup replaces this draft; restore the camera separately.
uk.render.setup_offline_help: You can edit and save this method without its renderer. Check and Start require an available host.
uk.render.setup_runtime_unsupported: This full job cannot be saved yet: it contains maps or scene-body bindings. Remove those temporary inputs before saving a portable setup.
uk.render.setup_save_missing: The saved render configuration could not be found after the command completed.
uk.render.shot_remove_help: Remove only this saved setup. Source geometry and completed images are preserved; the action can be undone.
uk.render.shot_saved_only: Save the current draft first. Duplicate and rename preserve exact saved options and resource references.
uk.render.studio_area_help: Up to four one-sided rectangles. Orthogonal half-edges U and V define size; U × V faces the lit side. Coordinates are world-space millimetres.
uk.render.studio_denoise: Reduce noise in the finished image
uk.render.studio_denoise_help: Final edge-aware filter; fine detail can soften. Glass and sharp specular surfaces bypass the filter.
uk.render.studio_environment_bounds: Environment rotation must be finite within ±1,000,000 radians and intensity between 0 and 100.
uk.render.studio_hdr_help: Radiance .hdr, 2:1 panorama, up to 2048 × 1024. EXR is unavailable. The color assumption applies only when primaries are unspecified.
uk.render.studio_hdr_srgb: Interpret unspecified primaries as linear sRGB
uk.render.studio_lens_perspective: Depth of field requires a perspective camera.
uk.render.studio_runtime_help: Numeric studio settings and checked HDR sources can be saved with the setup. Body optical/material overrides remain temporary and do not change saved appearances.
uk.render.studio_sky_help: Original sky gradient for lighting; not a calibrated atmospheric model.
uk.render.subsurface_help: Closed dielectric only. Scattering and RGB absorption are separate per-mm coefficients. Paths scatter inside actual geometry, then refract or reflect at the boundary. Disable straight shadow transmission, surface denoising and exterior volume; use one Fresnel stratum. Not a diffusion shader, density grid or measured material. Dense media may need more samples and path depth.
uk.render.transmission_scope: GPU glass supports certified disjoint media. Unrestricted nested media and a noise-free transmission estimator are not provided.
uk.render.transmission_strata_help: 1 preserves the original stream. 2 or 4 subpaths stratify the first glass reflection/transmission choice with unchanged Snell and absorption laws. More paths cost more work; this is not denoising, nested-media support or a promise of faster rendering.
uk.render.volume_help: GPU transport inside one finite box, with Beer attenuation and HG scattering on camera and indirect paths. Uses explicit studio/HDR/sky lighting, including shadow attenuation. Positive phase cosine scatters forward. Glass boundaries and surface denoising must be disabled explicitly. Zero extinction leaves transport unchanged. Not a physical lunar atmosphere, density grid, volume emission, spectral transport or certified material property.
uk.section.off_hint: No plane picked: OK turns the section off.
uk.settings.frame_rate_details_note: Adds a graph of the last frames' times with the triangles drawn over it, a histogram of frame times and what the GPU drew. Click the frame rate in the view to show or hide them.
uk.settings.reference_geometry_through_bodi: Draw inactive sketch contours and datum planes over shaded bodies
uk.settings.window_system_wayland_limited: Some features are limited on native Wayland.
uk.sheet.no_body: there is no sheet metal body: start one with Flange > Base, or turn a plate into sheet metal with Convert to Sheet Metal (pick its large flat face)
uk.timeline.delete_folders_tip: Keep their features and nested folders in the history
uk.timeline.feature_hint: Double-click to edit · drag to reorder · right-click for more
uk.ui.agent_chat_attach_selection_tip: Send what is selected in the model (faces, edges, features, bodies) with the message, so the agent knows what you mean
uk.ui.agent_chat_model_no_tools: {model} can't use SolidCraft's tools, so it can only chat. Pick a model with tool support.
uk.ui.agent_chat_no_tool_call: The model didn't use SolidCraft's tools, so the design wasn't changed. Choose a model that supports tool calling; see Local models in the agent chat guide.
uk.ui.agent_chat_pick_context_tip: Choose faces, edges, features and bodies in the model for the agent to look at, then press OK
uk.ui.agent_chat_provider_tip: The provider whose models the next list shows.
uk.ui.ai_request_timed_out: The model took longer than {seconds} s. You can raise the request timeout for this endpoint in Preferences › Assistant.
uk.ui.ai_request_timeout_hint: How long one model request to this endpoint may take, from 30 s to an hour. Raise it for a slow local model.
uk.ui.ai_test_anthropic_tip: Sends a short message to the endpoint
uk.ui.cosmetic_thread_markings_help: Show schematic markings on threaded cylindrical walls. Changes only the display, never the design or exports.
uk.ui.extract_design_changed: The design changed while choosing a file. Start Extract to File again.
uk.ui.extract_done: The component is now its own design, linked here.
uk.ui.extrude_auto_to_object_tip: In Extrude, with a profile picked, picking a face, vertex or parallel plane off its plane switches the extent to To Object
uk.ui.hide_origin_note: New designs start with the Origin folder hidden. A design keeps its own Origin setting once you show or hide it.
uk.ui.link_copies_text: These components build the same bodies as {name}. Make them placements of its link?
uk.ui.nav_bridge: Navigate with a device app on this computer
uk.ui.nav_bridge_tip: A 3D input device's own program (for example a homemade 3D mouse's driver) moves the view over a local connection, so the mouse pointer stays yours. SolidCraft connects to it on this port on this computer only.
uk.ui.placement_handles_tip: Handles on the preview of a Rest, Boss or Snap Fit: drag the marker to move it across the model, turn it by its ring
uk.ui.replace_with_link_done: The copies are now placements of the linked design.
uk.ui.save_mesh_no_slicer_open: No slicer found: choose Custom… and pick your slicer program
uk.ui.send_to_slicer_unavailable: Send to Slicer needs the desktop app: a browser can't start a program
uk.ui.sent_to_slicer_copy: Sent to {slicer} as {file}, because the first file is still open there
uk.ui.shortcut_capture_add_key: Add one ordinary key. Escape cancels.
uk.ui.shortcut_capture_hint: Click a binding, then press modifiers and one key. Add modifiers within one second; release all keys to confirm. Escape cancels.
uk.ui.shortcut_capture_press: Press modifiers and one key. Escape cancels.
uk.ui.shortcut_capture_release: Release all keys to confirm. Escape cancels.
uk.ui.shortcut_cycles_modes: Pressing a tool's shortcut again switches its mode
uk.ui.shortcut_cycles_modes_tip: Before the first point, pressing a sketch tool's shortcut again steps through its creation modes. Off: it starts the tool again.
uk.ui.shortcut_multiple_keys: Use modifiers and only one other key. Click the binding to try again.
uk.ui.slicer_lost: {slicer} was started but can't be found again to send it the file. The file is saved at {path}: open it from there.
uk.ui.slicer_no_file: {slicer} is ready, but there is no file to send to it.
uk.ui.slicer_no_response: {slicer} didn't respond in time. The file is already saved at {path}: send it again once the slicer has started.
uk.ui.slicer_resend_hint: Sending again replaces the file the slicer has open.
uk.ui.slicer_single_instance: Open files in a slicer that is already running
uk.ui.slicer_single_instance_tip: PrusaSlicer, SuperSlicer and Cura load the file in the window that is open instead of starting another. Other slicers are started as they are. PrusaSlicer 3.0 always does this: its launcher can't take a file any other way.
uk.ui.slicer_still_starting: Still waiting for {slicer} to start. Nothing else was sent.
uk.ui.slicer_stl_fallback: The 3MF could not be written, so this is an STL.
uk.ui.step_values: Step values with the arrow keys and the wheel
uk.ui.step_values_tip: In a value field you are typing in, Up/Down change a plain number by 1 (Shift: 10, Alt: 0.1), and so does the mouse wheel over the field. Expressions are left as typed.
uk.update.prefs_web: Reload the page to get the latest web app. If the network is unavailable or the update cannot finish downloading in time, the saved version opens instead; a download in progress continues for the next reload.
uk.view.auto_ortho_faces: Perspective while orbiting, ortho on faces
uk.web.files.insert_drawings_hint: CAD files, meshes, DXF or SVG into the open design
uk.web.files.insert_stored_drawings_hint: Into the open design (CAD files, meshes, DXF, SVG)
uk.web.open_link_confirm: There are unsaved changes. Open the linked design in a new tab?
